name: site-footer-section
purpose: The footer under every marketing page: the link columns, then the social row beside the status indicator and the language select. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'site-footer-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `footer`, `brand`, `icon-button`, `status-indicator` and `select`. From `lg` the Azion mark leads the social row of small icon buttons; below `lg` it moves into the footer's signature band, centred under the social row, as the design sample draws it. The status indicator fills the footer's `status` slot and the language select its `language` slot, so the bottom bar lays them out as `footer` does. The layout is CSS only, so the server HTML and the hydrated page are the same tree. The language select keeps its own value unless the page binds `v-model:language`; its options are the labels the reader sees.
useWhen: Use SiteFooterSection for the marketing site footer from page JSON.

Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → the section (`site-footer-section`). Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the primitive (`footer`).
As the last block of every marketing page.
avoidWhen: Inside the product console or the docs → compose `footer` directly.
For a closing ask above the footer → use `closing-call-to-action-section`.
related: `footer` — the composition footer this section fills.
`closing-call-to-action-section` — the band that sits right above it.
bestPractices: **Do** render it as the last child of the page shell, as is: it draws its own top rule, its frame and its closing bottom rule.
**Don't** wrap it in a bordered or padded `div` (`border-t`, `py-*`): the rules double and the frame drifts off the page column.
Use `variant: 'site'` under a framed marketing page, so the footer draws the page frame and closes on its bottom rule; the page above must not draw a bottom rule of its own.
Keep four link columns so the grid fills at `md`.

Set `target: '_blank'` on a link that leaves azion.com (Community, Status): it opens in a new tab, draws the external-link glyph after the label and tells assistive tech it opens a new tab. Never add the glyph yourself.
Give every social link a `label` that names the network, since the button shows only the glyph.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Where the footer sits: `site` closes a framed marketing page and draws its frame, `content` runs the bands full bleed.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the footer landmark. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Footer`).

props.name: home
props.doc: Destination of the Azion mark; the mark is not rendered when empty.

props.name: homeAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the Azion mark link. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Azion home`).

props.name: columns
props.doc: The link columns, in order; each is `{ title, links }` where every link is `{ label, href, target? }`; a `_blank` link opens in a new tab and closes on the external-link glyph.

props.name: socials
props.doc: The profile icon buttons, in order; each is `{ icon, label, href }` where `label` names the button for assistive tech. They open in a new tab.

props.name: statusLabel
props.doc: Line of the system status indicator; the indicator is not rendered when empty.

props.name: languages
props.doc: Options of the language select, as the reader sees them; the first one is selected until `v-model:language` holds another. The select is not rendered when empty.

props.name: languageAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the language select, also its placeholder. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Language`).
